text:
olivia.support: Hey team, customer accepted an org invite but gets 403 when trying to open the project console (billing tab and settings are greyed). They see \"permission denied\" in the UI. Root ts 1764123456.

devops-bot: Notified on-call and created incident INC-2026-0042 :rotating_light: 

olivia.support: Repro steps from the customer: 1) IdP SAML login -> redirect to Redwood invite flow 2) click accept invite 3) lands on org dashboard but clicking project -> 403. They can list org-level projects via API but console page returns 403.

sam.eng: Thanks Olivia. Can you paste the short SAML attribute payload or the user claim dump (masked)? Looking for role claim name and length.

olivia.support: Pasted from the customer's logs (redacted):
```
{"email":"jane+corp@example.com","groups":["eng-team-long-name-that-keeps-growing-2026"],"rdw_role":"organization:admin;project:read-only;billing:owner;extra:really-long-extra-claim-that-may-be-truncated-in-assertion"}
```

sam.eng: Hm. The `rdw_role` claim looks long. We had a bug where role claim strings > 256 bytes were being trimmed by the proxy layer and that produced an invalid role token, causing the UI auth check to fallback to deny. API listing worked because token scope was different for API calls.

mira.idp: From IdP side they confirmed the SAML assertion size is ~1.5KB for this user due to nested group names. SCIM mapping looks ok. No errors on their side.

olivia.support: Customer reports it worked yesterday, started failing after org turned on conditional MFA for Okta at 00:15 UTC. They accepted invite after MFA but got the 403.

sam.eng: MFA change on IdP could have changed assertion format (we saw an extra `auth_context` appended in a recent Okta rollout). That could push claim length over threshold. Can you repro locally with a long `rdw_role` claim?

sam.eng: Quick repro steps for eng:
1) POST to /internal/test-saml with body containing `rdw_role` ~1.2KB\2) Observe proxy logs at INFO

jacob.sre: I pulled proxy logs for the customer's timestamp. Saw: `WARN token-parser: claim truncated to 256 bytes for user jane+corp` followed by `ERROR auth: role-parsing-failed -> permission_denied`.

olivia.support: Suggested immediate workaround to customer: re-invite the user and have them accept before applying MFA policy (not ideal) or ask IdP to shorten the mapped role claim (short-term). They can't remove MFA.

sam.eng: Immediate mitigation we can do on our side: relax truncation and fall back to best-effort role parse instead of hard deny. But that is a policy decision. I'll open a PR to change parser to accept up to 4KB and attempt to parse semicolon-separated roles, with defensive checks.

mira.idp: We can also add a SCIM rule to map group names to shorter role tags (`eng-team` instead of full path) while they wait.

jacob.sre: For the incident ticket we should capture: repro steps, proxy log lines, IdP assertion size, customer impact (single user blocked from console UI, can use API). Also add a short-term ACL bypass for org admins? That has risk.

sam.eng: Agreed. Plan:
- HOTFIX: change parser to tolerant mode (parse up to 4KB) and deploy to staging for 30m smoke (sam)
- Customer workaround: IdP SCIM mapping or re-invite pre-MFA (olivia)
- Long-term: add telemetry and metrics on claim truncation and assertion size (jacob)

olivia.support: Customer ok with IdP mapping change but asked for ETA on platform fix. Can we provide ETA?

sam.eng: I'll have a staging build in 2 hours, can deploy to prod after 24h of observation, but if customer needs it sooner we can opt for a hot deploy with monitoring. ETA ~ 6-8 hours for hotfix deploy if we escalate.

mira.idp: We'll provide a SCIM rule within 1h and confirm once it's applied.

jacob.sre: I'll add an emergency dashboard showing `auth.claim_truncated` events and alert if rate >0 for five minutes.

olivia.support: Thanks all — updating customer that IdP will try short-term mapping and we're working a hotfix. Will follow up after staging smoke. :thumbsup:

sam.eng: NOTE: add unit test covering semicolon-separated role parsing and boundary conditions (256, 1024, 4096). Putting a ticket in sprint backlog.

devops-bot: Deployment PR opened: redwood/runtime#issue-4212 by sam.eng (hotfix-parser-tolerant).

olivia.support: Closing loop — customer confirmed SCIM mapping applied and console access restored for the user at 1764123980. They will keep MFA and do a few more invites to test.

jacob.sre: Incident summary to include root cause: role claim length exceeded parser limit after IdP auth_context appendix; remediation: parser tolerant mode + IdP mapping.

olivia.support: Marking resolved for now, will reopen if recurs. Thanks team! :heart:
